evidence.title: Kirkkonummi datacenter project updates
evidence.excerpt: Microsoft's April 2026 Kirkkonummi update says first-building façade and interior construction is underway and second-building foundations are progressing.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of 214625 content-decoded HTML response bytes retrieved after redirects
metadata.retrieval_method: curl --fail --location --compressed with retries disabled and the DataCenterAtlas research user agent
metadata.status_as_of_normalization: 2026-04-01 is the conservative month-start representation of the source's April 2026 update label, not an asserted observation day.
metadata.status_scope: The source explicitly says façade and interior construction of the first data-center building are currently underway and foundation work for the second data-center building is progressing.
metadata.site_identifier_as_reported: HEL04 appears in the official page's project contact address; it is retained only in evidence metadata and not promoted to an entity name or unique-site identifier.
metadata.coordinate_basis: Rounded analyst placement within the named Masala locality because the curated schema requires a point; it is not a source coordinate, address geocode, parcel, footprint, building centroid, or unique-site claim.
metadata.building_scope_guardrail: The two explicit building references support two project rows sharing one campus and one evidence record. They do not establish a complete campus building inventory.
metadata.metric_guardrail: No critical IT load, gross facility power, grid draw, generation, annual energy, PUE, workload, operating model, or completion claim is imported.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Satellite imagery and computer vision play no role in identity or lifecycle status.
